name: Diamond DA50 RG / DA50 C
summary: Five-seat composite piston single from Diamond, a larger sibling of the DA40 and DA62 with a T-tail and a roomy cabin.

engines: Single piston engine in a smooth nose
fuselage: Smooth, flush composite fuselage with a large wraparound canopy
Roomy five-seat cabin with large windows
tail: Tailplane perched on top of the fin

tellTales: Sleek, glossy composite single with a T-tail and big canopy

confusedWith.howToTell: The DA40 is smaller with fixed gear and a bubble canopy; the DA50 is larger with a roomier cabin and, in the RG, retracting gear.
The DA42 has two engines; the DA50 has one engine in the nose.
The Cirrus has a conventional low tailplane and fixed gear; the DA50 has a T-tail.
